name: fb-lane-coordination
description: Codex plugin for safe concurrent lane work using FB-Lane board claims, handoffs, and Product integration gates.

interface.shortDescription: Run concurrent Codex lanes without file collisions
interface.longDescription: FB-Lane Coordination packages Codex skills and an MCP server for lane-based project work. Codex supplies native concurrency; FB-Lane supplies the shared board, file claims, handoff docs, Product/Captain integration gate, and BFM return loop so multiple lane instructions can run at the same time without overwriting each other or closing before board, source, docs, tests, and git state agree.
defaultPrompt: Start here: use $fb-lane, run doctor if setup looks incomplete, show current status and file claims, then ask what I want to build.

Use $fb-lane to split this work across Product, Tech, Design, and Business. Use worktrees for code-writing lanes where helpful. Each lane should claim files, write handoffs, and return to Product for sequencing.

Run BFM as a return loop: read the board and handoffs, reconcile source/docs/tests, sequence the next slice, verify it, update durable state, and close only when every handoff is implemented, already done, blocked, out of scope, or explicitly deferred.
What is ready to merge? Read the board, lane handoffs, current file claims, verification evidence, and remaining gates before answering.
Bootstrap this repo for Codex only, then run doctor and report whether FB-Lane is ready.
